budget.basis: SIM MODEL allocation shares of forecast revenue for the annual budget (Session 05 Unit 07). Shares must sum to <= 1; the remainder is the planned reserve.

borrowing.basis: SIM MODEL: when the national treasury is in overdraft at budget time, the government may formalise part of the overdraft into an explicit SYS-BANK loan (Session 04 machinery; sovereign credit assessed on recorded government revenue).

country.basis: Citizen nationality in the merged identity data (identity.py: nationality='Bangladeshi'); Rupsha City is the Khulna-inspired District 1 of the design docs and hosts the national institutions.
country.name: Bangladesh

decision_engine.basis: SIM MODEL thresholds for the government decision engine (Unit 15). Every trigger reads measured indicators/facts; every action is logged.

development_plan.basis: SIM MODEL national development targets, measured only from Session 04 indicators and sim facts.
development_plan.name: National Development Plan v1

diplomacy.basis: The world contains ONE populated country. The external counterpart is an explicitly labelled model account (SYS-EXTERNAL), funded by a genesis grant from SYS-MARKET exactly like the bank's capital — it is a bookkeeping counterpart for trade/diplomacy flows, NOT a fabricated populated nation.

elections.basis: SIM MODEL election rules (no election design exists in the merged data).

integrity.basis: SIM MODEL accountability rules. Integrity is measured from audit discrepancies only; a clean ledger is a clean government.

judiciary.basis: SIM MODEL court rules. Judge eligibility has no design-data basis (there is no legal profession among the canonical 11), so it is an explicit rule: adult citizens with intelligence >= 70 who hold no executive or legislative office.

laws.basis: SIM MODEL legal bounds. Enacted laws may move these sim parameters only inside the bounds; the constitution (below) is data, and at least the tax and wage laws measurably change behaviour (proven by tests).

constitution.text: Every simulated citizen aged 18 or over may vote; one citizen, one ballot, recorded immutably.
Public money moves only through the ledger, with its cause recorded; public accounts are auditable by any citizen.
No institution may exercise an authority it does not hold; cross-branch acts are void.
An allegation is not a finding; only a court's recorded judgment establishes liability.
Office is temporary: terms end, records remain.

notes: Session 05 government configuration. Everything in this file is CONFIGURATION, not code: the country's identity is grounded in the project's own data (citizens carry nationality 'Bangladeshi' in tools/sim/identity.py; District 1 / Rupsha City hosts the national institutions per Session 04's labour model), election rules, party ideologies, office allowances, budget shares, policy parameters, legal bounds and integrity thresholds are simulation rules with no basis in the merged design data — each is labelled SIM MODEL and can be changed without touching engine code. Tax RATES are never copied here: canonical rates stay in prices.json (income brackets, business 8%, property 0.5%/yr, loan terms); laws may move the two SIM MODEL rates (sales tax, tariff) only inside the legal bounds configured below.

offices.basis: SIM MODEL monthly office allowances, paid from the institution's treasury account through the ledger (reason 'office_allowance'). Office holders keep their ordinary employment; the allowance is the office's recorded cost.

parties.basis: SIM MODEL genesis parties. Ideology is a stance vector over five dimensions (0-100): economy (market freedom), welfare (redistribution), services (public provision), development (construction/infrastructure priority), law_order (enforcement priority). Voters and parties are matched on these vectors; nothing about a party is hardcoded in engine code.

genesis.name: Janata Dal
genesis.platform: Welfare-first development: protect household incomes, fund services, build steadily.

genesis.name: Oikya Front
genesis.platform: Growth and enterprise: lighter burdens on business, faster construction, open trade.

genesis.name: Shanti League
genesis.platform: Order and community: public safety, strong local services, gradual change.

police.basis: SIM MODEL incident model. Incidents arise ONLY from simulated events (escalated Session 02 conflicts, court-relevant defaults) and from measured road risk (storm days x degraded segment condition) — never from a bare dice roll against citizens.

policies.basis: SIM MODEL policy parameters. Every policy's budget is real treasury money moved through the ledger with event_ref = the policy id, so spend is auditable to the last NCr.

welfare_support.poverty_line_basis: prices.json subsistence: lower-band monthly living costs + tier-1 rent (the indicators module's poverty definition)

scenarios_note: Configurable exogenous political scenarios, fired deterministically by month_index (e.g. a safety incident trigger for tests). Empty by default — nothing is invented for the standard world.
